description:
Check a domain's BIMI record (default._bimi.<domain> TXT), which points to the brand logo (and optional VMC) displayed next to authenticated mail. BIMI requires an enforced DMARC policy to take effect.

Args:
  - domain (string): the domain to check.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): output format (default 'markdown').

Returns: { found, record, findings[] }.

Example: "Does cnn.com have BIMI set up?" -> bimi_check(domain="cnn.com").

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary (default) or 'json' for the full structured payload.

name: bimi_check
title: BIMI Check
